title: [Inductor]record_functioninCompiledFxGraphseems to cause regression in workload
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Following #159318 we are observing a slowdow in a Megatron implementation of T5. Commenting out this context manager seemed to restore performance: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/f5bf5147ad18994c9a6e0f565d7831362bf5a18a/torch/_inductor/output_code.py#L585

### Versions

2.8/2.9

cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @jerryzh168 @chauhang @penguinwu
error_description: Following #159318 we are observing a slowdow in a Megatron implementation of T5. Commenting out this context manager seemed to restore performance: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/f5bf5147ad18994c9a6e0f565d7831362bf5a18a/torch/_inductor/output_code.py#L585
add_fix_code: annotations = [e.name for e in prof.events() if "Torch-Compiled" in e.name]
# Checking the profiler directly is faster than nullcontext
sub_fix_code: annotations = [e.name for e in prof.events() if "Compiled" in e.name]
